_comment: Vendored dependencies — no npm runtime packages. Use `scripts/vendor-update.sh blamejs <tag>` to update.
_about: blamejs.shop vendors a single framework — blamejs — which itself bundles every server-side crypto/identity dependency. The transitive packages blamejs ships are surfaced in its own MANIFEST.json at lib/vendor/blamejs/lib/vendor/MANIFEST.json — Trivy / Grype rely on that nested data for CVE attribution.

blamejs.author: blamejs contributors
blamejs._about: The Node framework blamejs.shop builds on. Vendored as a shallow git clone of the release tag at lib/vendor/blamejs/. Run `npm run vendor blamejs <vX.Y.Z>` to refresh.
blamejs.bundler: shallow git clone of release tag from github.com/blamejs/blamejs
